name: Can Gio
provinceNote: From 1 July 2025 the beach town is xã Cần Giờ, the old Long Hòa commune and Cần Thạnh town joined. Thạnh An remains its own commune in the reserve.
dotReason: Worth the night for the mangrove creek and the market by the sand.
summary: A mangrove biosphere reserve on the coast, explored by creek boat. Take a boat through the creeks, then the Rừng Sác base, the salt pans, and live seafood at Hàng Dương. A day from Ho Chi Minh City is enough, or one night in the beach town.
timeNeeded: A day, or a night in the beach town
fee: No single ticket for the whole reserve
getThere: About 1 hour 30 minutes or about 2 hours from Ho Chi Minh City, then the Bình Khánh ferry.
bestMonths: A dry morning on the creek
seoTitle: Can Gio travel guide — mangrove creek by boat, biosphere reserve
seoDescription: The mangrove creeks are the reason to stay, southeast of Ho Chi Minh City. The road is about 1 hour 30 minutes or about 2 hours, then the Bình Khánh ferry.
intro: You come for a mangrove creek by boat and the biosphere reserve. The frame is a creek: dark water in front, mangrove trunks through the middle, the canopy over the boat. You sleep in the beach town, xã Cần Giờ, or in a room the Vàm Sát tariff lists at the forest centre. No hotel brand. Ho Chi Minh City is the other night, when the city is the trip and this reserve is the day.

Leave early. On 30 April 2026 a holiday queue on Huỳnh Tấn Phát ran nearly two hours, and one traveler counted nearly three hours including the wait. On the water the crossing is about 10–15 minutes, about 1.2 km on the Soài Rạp. After the ferry, đường Rừng Sác is the forest road a 2019 market story calls about 30 km of trees. Visit HCMC gives the Sac Forest gate as 7:30–17:30. Vàm Sát’s own gate is 8:00–17:00 every day. They are different desks.

The evening is chợ hải sản Hàng Dương on đường Thạnh Thới, beside bãi 30 tháng 4. A 2019 story puts the sand about 50 m from the market. You point at a live animal and the stall cooks it, or you take a pan already on the fire. If you are still in town in the morning, Lăng Ông Thủy Tướng is the whale temple.
gettingAround: Visit HCMC says about 1 hour 30 minutes and about 50 km from the city centre to the forest, via Nguyễn Văn Linh, a right onto Huỳnh Tấn Phát, and phà Bình Khánh at the end of that road. Tuổi Trẻ, on 30 April 2026, says about 2 hours as the trip a future bridge would shorten. A 2019 market story also says about 50 km. For the Cần Thạnh salt village, Dân trí says about 30 km in the lead, about 60 km in the body of the same story, and about 30 km south from the old district centre.

From 18 March 2026 the ferry operator, Xí nghiệp Quản lý phà Thanh niên xung phong, charges 3,000 VND to walk or cycle, 8,000 VND for a motorbike, and 11,000 VND for a motorbike with a passenger. The story says cars under 30 seats rose about 1,000–2,000 VND. An earlier notice, from 5 May 2025, gives a walk or bicycle at 2,000 VND, a motorbike at 7,000 VND, and a car under 7 seats at 40,000 VND. That notice does not replace the March 2026 walk and motorbike fares.

The ferry was still the crossing on 13 September 2026. On 30 April 2026 Tuổi Trẻ gives the bridge at about 6.3 km, six lanes, and an investment of more than 13,200 billion VND, with groundbreaking in January 2026. The 13 September story’s lead says the whole line is about 7.3 km, and later in that story about 7 km, with a bridge portion of about 3 km. That September story says component 2 at about 10,668 billion VND including interest during construction. The two sums may be different slices of the project. A planned start on 25 August 2026 and a BT contract on 20 September 2026 had not been met when that story ran. A future high-speed line from Bến Thành to Cần Giờ is named in the September story.

From 1 August 2025, Phương Trang’s subsidized list includes MST 90 from Phà Bình Khánh to Cần Thạnh, MST 77 from Đồng Hòa to Cần Thạnh, and MST 128 from Tân Điền to An Nghĩa. Free rides on that list cover children at or under 1.3 m, war wounded and sick soldiers, disabled riders, people 70 and over, and holders of a free-bus card. Visit HCMC still names route 20 to the ferry and then route 90, or route 75 direct from Công viên 23/9. Routes 20 and 75 are not on the August 2025 list. A 2019 story gives route 75 at 20,000 VND. A 2019 hydrofoil from Bến Bạch Đằng to biển Cần Thạnh gives an adult one-way fare of 200,000 VND.

Sleep in xã Cần Giờ, or in the rooms the Vàm Sát tariff lists at the forest centre. No hotel brand. Vàm Sát boats leave from cầu Dần Xây. The management board is at 1541 đường Rừng Sác. A motorbike is the mode Visit HCMC and the 2019 story both describe. The bird add-on at Vàm Sát is sold from May through October. Visit HCMC puts a Tràm Chim breeding season from April through October.

stayAreas.name: The beach town
stayAreas.summary: Sleep in xã Cần Giờ, the old Cần Thạnh town and Long Hòa commune joined on 1 July 2025, if the night you want is Hàng Dương and the sand. No hotel brand.

stayAreas.name: Vàm Sát centre
stayAreas.summary: The operator says family rooms and dorms at the forest centre, with breakfast included on the family room. No hotel brand.

eat: Hàng Dương, on đường Thạnh Thới, is the seafood market beside bãi 30 tháng 4. You choose a live animal and the stall cooks it, or you take a pan already on the fire. A 2019 story puts the sand about 50 m away. One seller that year said she sold from about 7:00 until about 21:00. That clock is one stall in 2019. Thanh Niên gives cook fees that year.

Đường Duyên Hải and đường Tắc Xuất are the sit-down streets in the old town centre, now xã Cần Giờ. Dân Việt, on 2 Oct 2022, names lẩu cá dứa, cá dứa kho, tôm tích, ốc len, sò huyết, vọp, hàu nướng, and cá đuối hấp there. Dân Việt, on 28 Apr 2024, names the mudskipper salad, ba khía with lá buôi, salt-crusted mullet, and straw-grilled duck, and rượu mật ong rừng Sác with the salad. It does not name a street for those plates. Salt is what people carry home from the pans.

The picture is the creek. The evening is the market and the black sand. The whale temple is the pin for lunar month 8, and a short visit on an ordinary morning.
Salt is a December–May morning on the pans. The rooms at Vàm Sát are a forest overnight.

interestGroups.title: The mangrove
interestGroups.summary: For a dry morning on the water, when the creek is the reason you came.
body: This is the mangrove biosphere. The biodiversity agency calls it the city’s green lung. UNESCO’s nomination year is 2000. The biosphere board dates recognition to 21 January 2000 and calls it Vietnam’s first. Habitats on the UNESCO page are mangroves, wetlands, salt marshes, mudflats, and seagrasses. The soil is river silt from the Sài Gòn and Đồng Nai, plus a brackish water table. The board says people live in the transition zone. The core and the buffer are forest-guard households, staff, and a few traditional shrimp traps.

Four sources give four areas. UNESCO says 75,740 ha and a population of 71,157 with no year on the page. The biosphere board says 70,445.34 ha and more than 75,000 people in 2018. The biodiversity agency says more than 75,000 hectares, with a core of 4,721 ha, a buffer of 41,139 ha, and a transition of 29,880 ha. The board’s zones differ: a core of 6,134.43 ha, a buffer of 29,152.10 ha of forest land and 12,763.56 ha of water, and a transition of 13,227.79 ha of forest land and 7,267.47 ha of water. A 2012 IUCN evaluation said 71,964 ha and 67,272 people in November 2011.

Vàm Sát is the forest centre. The tariff still says xã Lý Nhơn. From 1 July 2025 that commune sits inside xã An Thới Đông. The road gate is 60,000 VND, shuttle included, on the operator tariff and on Visit HCMC. Under 6 is free, ages 6–11 pay half, and over 11 is an adult ticket. The gate is 8:00–17:00 every day. From cầu Dần Xây the operator’s canoe is 1,075,000 VND for one person, 650,000 for two, 440,000 for three, 320,000 for four to seven, 300,000 for eight to eighteen, and 270,000 from nineteen. Visit HCMC says that canoe leg as from 270,000 VND to 895,000 VND. A full water package on the operator’s table runs from 1,335,000 VND for one canoe down to 550,000 from nineteen. The wooden boat on that package is 445,000 from nineteen. A package without Tràm Chim is lower, from 1,260,000 for one canoe to 370,000 for a wooden boat from nineteen. Visit HCMC says a full-service band of 550,000–1,175,000. The operator’s 1,335,000 top and Visit HCMC’s 1,175,000 top are different. Add-ons both pages give include a crocodile swamp shuttle at 20,000 VND, a caged crocodile boat at 60,000, a bird reserve at 55,000 from May through October, a rowing boat at Đầm Dơi at 65,000, and a canoe to Đầm Dơi at 185,000.

The same tariff says a family room for two at 400,000 VND for a weekday day and 600,000 for a weekday night. A weekend day is 500,000 and a weekend night is 750,000, with breakfast included. A third person is an extra 200,000 on a weekday or 250,000 on a weekend. A dorm bed is 150,000 for a weekday day and 200,000 for a weekday night. A weekend day is 200,000 and a weekend night is 250,000. These are the operator’s rooms.

Under 6 is free at that road gate, ages 6–11 pay half, and over 11 is an adult ticket. The biosphere board says more than 1,000 long-tailed macaques. Visit HCMC says over 2,000 monkeys, and a separate Monkey Island entrance of 35,000 VND a person, marked for reference. That 35,000 VND line and the 60,000 road gate are different desks. The board says about 2,000 birds of 33 species at Sân Chim Vàm Sát, and more than 500 bats at Đầm Dơi. Visit HCMC says over 30 bird species and about 20,000 birds at Tràm Chim.

cards.title: Vàm Sát
cards.summary: The forest centre. Road gate 60,000 VND with the shuttle, open 8:00–17:00 every day.

interestGroups.title: The Rừng Sác base
interestGroups.summary: For the rebuilt special-forces camp in this mangrove, once you are on the forest road.
body: You walk or take a canoe into the rebuilt camp. Visit HCMC names observation posts, a military workshop, an information house, hideouts, a medical station, a supply house, and figures of Unit 10, including the raid on the Nhà Bè oil depot. The biosphere board dates the national historic listing to 2004. UNESCO notes revolutionary use of the region in the wars against France and the United States. The biodiversity agency says defoliant was sprayed many times from 1964 to 1972 and that more than 80% of the old mangrove died.

Resolution 09/2020/NQ-HĐND, effective 1 January 2021, sets an adult fee of 35,000 VND a visit, domestic and foreign. Free: older people, disabled people, the armed forces, people with revolutionary merit, the veterans’ association, poor households, and children under 7. Half price: children from 7 to under 16, pupils, and students. Collection is assigned to the Củ Chi tunnels historic site. The open copy did not show whether that resolution was still in force in 2026. Visit HCMC says the same 35,000 VND for the combat zone and says its prices are for reference. Visit HCMC also says a canoe at 600,000 VND a turn, round trip. The resolution does not mention a canoe.

Visit HCMC gives the Sac Forest gate as 7:30–17:30. That is not Vàm Sát’s 8:00–17:00. The same tourism page names nearly 400 battles and 860 dead, and later on the page thousands of large and small battles. Unit 10 and the years 1966 to 30 April 1975 are in the history section. The old address is đường Rừng Sác in xã Long Hòa, now part of xã Cần Giờ.

cards.title: Rừng Sác base
cards.summary: Adult 35,000 VND on the 2020 resolution and on Visit HCMC. The 2026 force of that resolution was not shown.

interestGroups.title: The town beach
interestGroups.summary: For the late afternoon, when the market is cooking and the sand is a short walk.
body: Bãi 30 tháng 4 sits beside Hàng Dương, in the old xã Long Hòa, now xã Cần Giờ. A 2019 story calls the beach still rough and about 50 m from the market, and says people sit on the shore after eating. Dân trí calls the Cần Giờ sand black from silt.
Go late, when the market is cooking.

cards.title: 30 April beach
cards.summary: Black sand about 50 m from Hàng Dương.

interestGroups.title: Salt pans
interestGroups.summary: For a dry-season morning, December to May, if the raking is the reason you came.
body: The pans are along đường Duyên Hải in the old town, in the fields at Lý Nhơn, now inside xã An Thới Đông, and on đảo Thiềng Liềng in xã Thạnh An. Phụ Nữ, on 10 March 2024, says about 1,500 ha at those three places, and crystals in 7–10 days of hard sun. Dân trí, on 14 January 2020, says about 1,200 ha in production, more than 1,000 ha on tarpaulin, a yield of 80 tons a hectare, and 7–9 days from the first crystal to harvest. Both stories put the season at December–May. Most pans now crystallize on tarpaulin, Phụ Nữ says. The city recognized the Cần Thạnh village as a traditional craft village.

Go after sunrise on a hard sunny day. Dân trí says the picture is at dawn, and that the heavy part of the job is the noon rake. Thạnh An is the island commune the 2025 resolution did not rearrange. Salt is what people carry home. No shop is named.

cards.title: The salt morning
cards.summary: December to May, after sunrise. About 1,500 ha in one story and about 1,200 ha in production in the other.

faqs.q: How long is the ride from Ho Chi Minh City?
faqs.a: Visit HCMC says about 1 hour 30 minutes and about 50 km to the forest, via Nguyễn Văn Linh and Huỳnh Tấn Phát to the Bình Khánh ferry. Tuổi Trẻ says about 2 hours as the trip a bridge would shorten. On the water the ferry is about 10–15 minutes. A holiday queue is separate: nearly 2 hours on Huỳnh Tấn Phát on 30 April 2026, and one traveler’s nearly 3 hours including the wait.

faqs.q: Is there one ticket for the reserve?
faqs.a: There is no single gate for the whole reserve. Vàm Sát’s road gate is 60,000 VND, shuttle included, on the operator tariff and on Visit HCMC. The Rừng Sác relic is 35,000 VND for an adult on the 2020 city resolution and on Visit HCMC. The open copy did not show whether that resolution was still in force in 2026.

faqs.q: Can you drive the new bridge?
faqs.a: The ferry was still the crossing in a 13 September 2026 story. That story says about 7.3 km in the lead and about 7 km later, with a bridge portion of about 3 km. A 30 April 2026 story says about 6.3 km.

The culture department’s page, stamped 7 November 2018, puts the festival on the 15th through the 17th of lunar month 8, with the sea rite at 10:00 on the 16th. A 2025 city story puts 5–7 October 2025, lunar 14–16, and the sea rite at 9:00 on 7 October. A 2026 paper puts 23–27 September 2026, with the procession on 26 September and no lunar date. Keep both the 9:00 and the 10:00 clocks. The palanquin leaves Lăng Ông Thủy Tướng.

season.label: Dry mornings on the creek
season.note: Visit HCMC says to skip a storm day and does not name the wet months. Salt work is December–May on both salt stories. The Vàm Sát bird add-on is May through October, and Visit HCMC puts Tràm Chim breeding from April through October. Nghinh Ông sits in lunar month 8: the culture department says the 15th–17th with the sea rite at 10:00 on the 16th, a 2025 story says lunar 14–16 with the rite at 9:00, and a 2026 paper says 23–27 September with the procession on 26 September. A holiday can jam the Bình Khánh ferry. The bridge is not open.
